reference_lighting_regression.method: Byte-for-byte CSV comparison of all probe SH coefficients and validity after convergence, same geometry/lights; no image quality claim.

automation.temporary_setting: CommonUI.Debug.CheckGameViewportClientValid disabled for existing integration test and restored to 1.

memory.excludes: Local asset buffers, scan scratch, audit/readback buffers, allocator/RHI overhead. Computed sizes, not GPU memory measurements.

limitations: New pool GPU time not measured; SnapshotMs and ConvergenceSeconds in live status belong to reference lighting.
Full spatial grid rebuild on geometry change; fixed capacity with contiguous allocation and possible fragmentation.
Local sampling density changes under instance scale; no adaptive world density or LOD.
Diagnostic queries traverse 16 levels x 27 cells; not a production resolve.
No lighting cache, temporal filtering, radial depth or screen-space spawning yet.
PC editor validation only; mobile and cooked serialization untested.
